title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 1, 2026, relative to the Professional Services Agreement
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 1, 2026, relative to the Professional Services Agreement
  between the City of Los Angeles and the Superior Court of California, as set forth. [BPC #26-314]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor.
summary: The Board is asked to approve and forward to the Mayor a Police Department report on a professional services agreement between the City and the Superior Court of California.
